name: Computer (desklink)
provides: The bot's own desktop: a virtual display with its own Chromium, which its browser tool drives. You can watch it and take over from the Screen tab

install.system: Install Xvfb (apt install xvfb, dnf install xorg-x11-server-Xvfb, pacman -S xorg-server-xvfb) and Chromium. The desklink engine ships with Crewhouse (Linux x64)

asks: nothing while you watch; taking over pauses it until you give the controls back
note: Linux only for now. Nothing reaches your own screen: the bot's display has its own X cookie.
